echoParts: In the days of those kings
verseText: In the days of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed...
meaning: Earthly kingdoms do not last forever. But Jesus' kingdom will last forever, and no one will ever be able to destroy it.

recall.question: What kind of kingdom will God set up?
choices: One that will never be destroyed

meaning.question: How is God's kingdom different from earthly kingdoms?

application.prompt: When earthly powers seem important, remember that Jesus' kingdom is the one that lasts forever.
